title: Utterly Garlicky French Broccoli Stew
description: A hearty and comforting French stew featuring broccoli, dumplings, and a rich garlicky flavor, inspired by the cuisine of Normandy, made in a kadhai and suitable for halal diets.
instructions: In a large kadhai, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the broccoli florets and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, egg, and a pinch of salt to make the dumpling mixture.
Gradually add the chicken broth and milk to the kadhai, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the broccoli is tender.
Using a spoon, drop the dumpling mixture into the simmering stew, covering the kadhai with a lid.
Cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the dumplings are cooked through and float to the surface.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
